Checks.name: CK_InventoryMovements_Reference
Checks.definition: ([MovementType]='RECEIPT' AND [ReceiptItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [OrderItemId] IS NULL AND [TransferItemId] IS NULL AND [ReturnItemId] IS NULL AND [StocktakeItemId] IS NULL OR [MovementType]='SALE' AND [ReceiptItemId] IS NULL AND [OrderItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [TransferItemId] IS NULL AND [ReturnItemId] IS NULL AND [StocktakeItemId] IS NULL OR ([MovementType]='TRANSFER_IN' OR [MovementType]='TRANSFER_OUT') AND [ReceiptItemId] IS NULL AND [OrderItemId] IS NULL AND [TransferItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [ReturnItemId] IS NULL AND [StocktakeItemId] IS NULL OR [MovementType]='RETURN' AND [ReceiptItemId] IS NULL AND [OrderItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [TransferItemId] IS NULL AND [ReturnItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [StocktakeItemId] IS NULL OR [MovementType]='ADJUSTMENT' AND [ReceiptItemId] IS NULL AND [OrderItemId] IS NULL AND [TransferItemId] IS NULL AND [ReturnItemId] IS NULL AND [StocktakeItemId] IS NOT NULL AND [Reason] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_InventoryMovements_Stores
Checks.definition: (([MovementType]='RETURN' OR [MovementType]='RECEIPT') AND [FromStoreId] IS NULL AND [ToStoreId] IS NOT NULL OR [MovementType]='SALE' AND [FromStoreId] IS NOT NULL AND [ToStoreId] IS NULL OR ([MovementType]='TRANSFER_IN' OR [MovementType]='TRANSFER_OUT') AND [FromStoreId] IS NOT NULL AND [ToStoreId] IS NOT NULL AND [FromStoreId]<>[ToStoreId] OR [MovementType]='ADJUSTMENT' AND ([FromStoreId] IS NOT NULL OR [ToStoreId] IS NOT NULL))

Checks.name: CK_MediaAssets_Owner
Checks.definition: ((((case when [BookId] IS NULL then (0) else (1) end+case when [CopyId] IS NULL then (0) else (1) end)+case when [AuthorId] IS NULL then (0) else (1) end)+case when [UserId] IS NULL then (0) else (1) end)=(1))

Checks.name: CK_MediaAssets_Size
Checks.definition: (([Width] IS NULL OR [Width]>(0)) AND ([Height] IS NULL OR [Height]>(0)) AND [SortOrder]>=(0))

Checks.name: CK_MediaAssets_Url
Checks.definition: ([Provider]='LOCAL' AND [Url] like '/images/%' OR [Provider]='CLOUDINARY' AND [Url] like 'https://%' AND [PublicId] IS NOT NULL AND len([PublicId])>(0))

Checks.name: CK_Orders_Actor
Checks.definition: ([Channel]='ONLINE' AND [CustomerId] IS NOT NULL OR [Channel]='POS' AND [CreatedBy] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_OrderStatusHistory_From
Checks.definition: ([FromStatus] IS NULL OR ([FromStatus]='CANCELLED' OR [FromStatus]='COMPLETED' OR [FromStatus]='SHIPPED' OR [FromStatus]='PROCESSING' OR [FromStatus]='CONFIRMED' OR [FromStatus]='PENDING'))

Checks.name: CK_Payments_Paid
Checks.definition: ([Status]='SUCCEEDED' AND [PaidAt] IS NOT NULL AND [PaidAt]>=[CreatedAt] OR [Status]<>'SUCCEEDED' AND [PaidAt] IS NULL)

Checks.name: CK_PurchaseReceipts_Received
Checks.definition: ([Status]='RECEIVED' AND [ReceivedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [ReceivedAt]>=[CreatedAt] OR ([Status]='CANCELLED' OR [Status]='DRAFT') AND [ReceivedAt] IS NULL)

Checks.name: CK_RefreshTokens_Replacement
Checks.definition: ([ReplacedByTokenId] IS NULL OR [ReplacedByTokenId]<>[RefreshTokenId] AND [RevokedAt] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_Refunds_Date
Checks.definition: ([Status]='SUCCEEDED' AND [RefundedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [RefundedAt]>=[CreatedAt] OR [Status]<>'SUCCEEDED' AND [RefundedAt] IS NULL)

Checks.name: CK_SalesReturnItems_Accepted
Checks.definition: ([Status]<>'ACCEPTED' OR [ReceivedConditionId] IS NOT NULL AND [Resolution] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_SalesReturns_Approval
Checks.definition: (NOT ([Status]='COMPLETED' OR [Status]='APPROVED') OR [ProcessedBy] IS NOT NULL AND [ApprovedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [ApprovedAt]>=[CreatedAt])

Checks.name: CK_StaffAssignments_Dates
Checks.definition: ([Status]='ACTIVE' AND [EndAt] IS NULL OR [Status]='ENDED' AND [EndAt] IS NOT NULL AND [EndAt]>=[StartAt])

Checks.name: CK_StockReservations_Dates
Checks.definition: ([ExpiresAt]>[ReservedAt] AND ([Status]='ACTIVE' AND [ReleasedAt] IS NULL OR [Status]<>'ACTIVE' AND [ReleasedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [ReleasedAt]>=[ReservedAt]))

Checks.name: CK_StocktakeItems_Condition
Checks.definition: ([ActualPresent] IS NULL OR [ActualPresent]=(0) OR [ActualConditionId] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_Stocktakes_Dates
Checks.definition: (([StartedAt] IS NULL OR [StartedAt]>=[CreatedAt]) AND ([FinalizedAt] IS NULL OR [StartedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [FinalizedAt]>=[StartedAt]))

Checks.name: CK_Stocktakes_Finalized
Checks.definition: ([Status]<>'FINALIZED' OR [FinalizedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [ApprovedBy] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_StockTransfers_Approval
Checks.definition: (NOT ([Status]='RECEIVED' OR [Status]='IN_TRANSIT' OR [Status]='APPROVED') OR [ApprovedBy] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.name: CK_StockTransfers_Dates
Checks.definition: (([ShippedAt] IS NULL OR [ShippedAt]>=[CreatedAt]) AND ([ReceivedAt] IS NULL OR [ShippedAt] IS NOT NULL AND [ReceivedAt]>=[ShippedAt]))

Checks.name: CK_Users_Required
Checks.definition: (len(ltrim(rtrim([Username])))>(0) AND len(ltrim(rtrim([Email])))>(0) AND len(ltrim(rtrim([FullName])))>(0) AND len([PasswordHash])>(0))
